description: Rows each GPU and route must cover for full candidate acceptance or a development-only rehearsal, and the frozen limit hashes and contract tag (qualification_protocol.md, E5). accept.py reads only this file for the required rows; command-line flags cannot change them.

recipe.note: The acceptance recipe, the step 0 off recipe (qualification_protocol.md, E5). Every run is built by run_rows.build_command from its manifest row and the logged seeds, with `extra` (full runs: off, candidate, repeat, H3 extra seeds) or `tier1_extra` (tier 1 capture runs) appended; candidate runs then append the draw's candidate_args. `env` is the inference environment every run must have beyond its row's env (empty: LAYERNORM_TYPE and every OPENDDE_ variable unset); `host_env` names host-specific variables that are recorded but not compared. `diffusion_chunk_size` is the sampler chunk size every traced rollout must record.

port-chosen.note: Every sm_120 dispatch row is port-chosen (protocol, when a held-out draw is required).

dev-rehearsal.note: Development-only rehearsal of a candidate before any held-out draw (qualification_protocol.md, E5). The evidence names code_commit and candidate_args instead of a held-out draw; every check that does not need a draw runs, a declared freeze is required, and a pass exits 4, never 0. The rehearsed development runs become the development set of the final acceptance.

frozen.note: Frozen on 2026-10-12 by user approval as qual-sm120-contract-1, amended the same day as qual-sm120-contract-2 (adds the dev-rehearsal route), qual-sm120-contract-3 (binds full acceptance to a pre-draw rehearsal receipt, one draw per candidate, newest contract tag) and qual-sm120-contract-4 (adds the independent contract-version gate qual_gate.py and the receipt's contract tag); limit files and hashes unchanged; earlier tags superseded. The commit setting these values is tagged contract_tag and the tag is pushed. Run qual_gate.py from a checkout of the approved tag before accept.py; accept.py requires both hashes to match, the tag to be the newest of its family, and the draw's code commit to descend from it with scripts/qualification unchanged apart from the held-out log. Changing anything under scripts/qualification needs a contract amendment and a new tag; no tag may be created while a draw is open.
